design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 of payment_plan_servicing (24-Month Extended Plan signing).

[Step 0 - draw] scripts/draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0 printed: {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 4]}. Assignment: encounter-charge enrollment 5 factors, setup fee 5 factors, signing installment 4 factors.

[Why this is a good test] The patient only says she wants to sign the plan the counselor prepared. A correct seat must (1) read the signing-installment rule and discover two prerequisite sentences that wait on record states - 'The signed installment is fixed only after the plan balance carries the setup-fee entry the tier owes at signing.' and 'The signed installment is not fixed until the plan carries an enrollment entry for every charge the financial account posted for an encounter already enrolled on it.' - (2) check the ledgers and find both states false (no setup_fee entry; the second charge of ENC-58302716 posted 2026-10-06 is not enrolled), (3) work out from the other rules which writes bring those states about (setup-fee rule; encounter-charge rule), (4) compute three figures, each through 4-5 record-decided factors over the plan ledger and the Patient Financial Account of the billing difficulty, and (5) hand the signature to the patient. Difficulty comes from reading policy, reconciling two ledgers and arithmetic, not from tool choice: each write has exactly one tool.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed: payplan_ext_encounter_charge_enrollment, payplan_ext_signing_setup_fee, payplan_ext_signing_installment; tools enroll_encounter_charge_372696d1, enroll_setup_fee_08ffaf93, sign_installment_agreement_b4bb7ade. Left for task 1 (draw: 3 prerequisites, factors [5,5,4,5]): the add-on line on an ACTIVE plan (add-on enrollment, add-on fee, term extension, the patient's acceptance of the re-spread installment) - payplan_modified and add_on enrollments are untouched here, so task 1 has an independent tree.

[Problem-tree card]
root payplan_ext_signing_installment (user tool sign_installment_agreement_b4bb7ade).
edge 1 -> payplan_ext_encounter_charge_enrollment: kind value_input, gate plan_balance, form state, sentence (affirmative/negated check: negated direction 'is not fixed until'; its affirmative rewrite 'is fixed only after the plan carries an enrollment entry for every charge ...' adds or drops nothing). Four-point test: ordering connective 'not ... until'; waits on a record state (an enrollment entry per charge of an enrolled encounter); no tool/id/snake token; strength 'every charge ... for an encounter already enrolled on it' = exactly the condition. Exactly one write brings the state about: the encounter-charge rule ('a charge the financial account posts for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed plan, and not yet on that plan, is enrolled on it as an initial enrollment'); the add-on rule of task 1 applies only to active plans. False at opening: initial_state.payplan_transactions.7cef0a22-691a-4657-88df-81734590fc3f.billing_txn_id = f2ed445c-e7cb-4b2e-9d80-0e5ec6ea6d72 is the only entry; initial_state.billing_transactions.36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21.encounter_number = ENC-58302716 (same encounter) posted 2026-10-06.
edge 2 -> payplan_ext_signing_setup_fee: kind value_input, gate plan_balance, form state, sentence 'The signed installment is fixed only after the plan balance carries the setup-fee entry the tier owes at signing.' (affirmative). Exactly one write books a setup-fee entry at signing (the setup-fee rule; task 1's add-on fee is booked with an add-on, not at signing). False at opening: initial_state.payplan_transactions.7cef0a22-691a-4657-88df-81734590fc3f.enroll_reason = initial_enrollment is the plan's only entry, tier 24-Month Extended Plan has setup_fee_usd 25.00.
Derivation: sentence + ledger (no such entry) + the setup-fee rule ('the plan balance is charged the setup fee as one enrollment entry of reason setup_fee') -> the setup-fee write; sentence + ledger + account ledger (second ENC-58302716 charge) + encounter-charge rule -> that enrollment. Both forms are state forms; no fallback needed.
Topological order: encounter charge, setup fee, signing (gold steps 7, 9, 11). Parallel edges commute (proved by replay: setup-fee pair moved first -> identical terminal DB, installment 209.00 either way; the balance-size share is 0.90 whether the enrolled charges are 5287.50 or 5704.31).
Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skip step 7 -> installment 193.00; skip step 9 -> installment 208.00; gold 209.00. Owner=user: the signature (base: 'accepting a payment obligation is the patient's own act and is never done for them'); it is synchronous - no payment is taken (down payment 0.00 under the hardship tier).
user_scenario names neither prerequisite; tools validate nothing (each is one create/update).

[Base-invariant card] Write subjects: payplan_balance_enrolled (steps 7, 9) governed by payplan_charge_eligibility (enroll_when_open: plan status proposed - initial_state.payment_plans.c637bf74-c4fd-4d73-90bc-ca19da1f3135.status = proposed; charge_enrolled_once: 36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21 has no enrollment entry - retired globally by the setup-fee overwrite but still evidenced for step 7) and payplan_add_on_and_modification (scope only; its gate modify_when_active applies to payplan_modified). payplan_agreement_signed (step 11) governed by payplan_agreement_and_activation, gate signed_in_time (time): anchor payment_plans.proposed_date 2026-10-01, duration variants.proposal_valid_days 14, calendar days from the day after, inclusive -> last day 2026-10-15; frozen 2026-10-13 is day 12 (positive); 2026-10-16 would fail (negative). Entry gate of the 24-Month tier holds at the opening: enrolled 5287.50 in [2500, 20000], autopay ach, no default within 24 months (the 2021 plan was paid off), counselor-reviewed (the proposal exists). Overwrites declared: enrollment_terms down-payment sentence and installment sentence (signing installment), setup-fee sentence and the charge dedup sentence (setup fee), charge_eligibility 'Each charge is enrolled at its remaining balance on the enrollment date.' (encounter charge).

[Business-object card] Target plan c637bf74-c4fd-4d73-90bc-ca19da1f3135 (the only proposed plan). Encounter ENC-58302716: charge f2ed445c-e7cb-4b2e-9d80-0e5ec6ea6d72 (12400.00, collected 400.00, paid 250.00 card, hardship adjustment 6462.50 on 2026-09-22 -> enrolled 5287.50 on 2026-10-01) and charge 36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21 (1120.00, estimate 780.00, posted 2026-10-06, a 60.00 check 2026-10-09, no hardship adjustment because it posted after the 2026-09-22 hardship pass). Excluded: every other charge (2021 ENC-50417262 paid through the old plan; 2024 ENC-52290431 and its late fee, paid; 2026 ENC-57118045 and its returned-payment fee, paid). The enrollment tool carries billing_txn_id = 36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21.

[Factor card] (tier taken / evidence / baseline figure)
Encounter charge (416.81; all-baseline 1060.00): estimate cap - PPO with estimate 780.00 -> 975.00 (baseline full 1120.00 -> 478.80); payment clearing (method) - 1 reversal (ACH 2026-02-17) -> the 2026-10-09 check is not credited (baseline credits it -> 391.16); hardship relief 55.00 >= 50 and covered -> 0.50 (-> 833.63); prompt-pay - 7 days, ach -> 5.00 (-> 438.75); late posting 83 days -> 0.90 (-> 463.13). Near-miss: the 60.00 check is a real payment a careless reader credits.
Setup fee (7.00; all-baseline 25.00): autopay ach and no late fee < 12 months (near-miss: the 2024-11-14 late fee is 22 months old) -> 0.80 (-> 9.00); tenure 161 months -> 0.80 (-> 9.00); hardship 55.00 -> 0.60 (-> 11.00); balance size 5704.31 -> 0.90 (-> 8.00); returning-plan method, 6 payment_plan payments -> x0.75 rounded up (-> 8.64).
Signing installment (209.00; all-baseline 202.32): down payment 0.00 (baseline 15 percent = 855.65 -> 177.00); first phase PPO x0.90 floor (-> 232.97); autopay credit 3.00 (-> 212.00); returning-plan credit 2.00 (-> 211.00). Stale stamps: the proposal's installment 187.27 and down payment 793.13 are the counselor's standard figures; no rule reads them.
Cross-difficulty factors read the billing product (Patient Financial Account and billing_transactions) seeded for this patient; multi-source factors: autopay share, hardship share, relief share, prompt-pay rate, estimate cap, down payment.

[Seed rows] customer; billing account (PPO, opened 2013-05-06, approval 55.00 through 2027-03-31, paperless, balance 6347.50 = sum of deltas); 21 billing rows (2021 charge + 6 payment_plan payments; 2024 charge/statement/late fee/2 payments; 2026 ACH payment, reversal, returned-payment fee, 2 card payments; surgery collection, charge, statement, payment, hardship adjustment; late-posted charge and its check); 2 plans (paid-off 2021 plan; proposal); 8 plan ledger rows. Removing the reversal flips the clearing tier; removing the 2021 payments flips both returning-plan factors; removing 36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21 removes the prerequisite. No unsettled status other than the proposal (handled here) and 36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21 (handled here).

[Persona] Nadia Whitfield, librarian, hurried and warm. Volunteers only the signing request; identity on request (name/phone locate, DOB verify); remembers the counselor's printout figures (the stale stamps) and asks once for a re-check if a figure differs, never supplying a number; agrees when told something must be booked first; keeps ach and due day 18 if asked; signs with the figures read to her; closes when told the plan is active. No template labels.

[Standard solution] find_customers(name, phone) -> verify (DOB, phone) -> plans -> plan ledger -> account -> account ledger -> unlock/call enroll_encounter_charge_372696d1(plan, 36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21, 416.81) -> unlock/call enroll_setup_fee_08ffaf93(plan, 7.00) -> unlock_user/call_user sign_installment_agreement_b4bb7ade(plan, 209.00, 0.00, 2026-11-18). First due date: signing 2026-10-13 + 30 days = 2026-11-12, first day 18 on/after -> 2026-11-18.

[Verification run] scratch evaluator replaying gold writes to each handling time (removed after authoring) printed: encounter charge 416.81 (baselines 478.8 / 391.16 / 833.63 / 438.75 / 463.13, all 1060.0); setup fee 7.0 (9.0 / 9.0 / 11.0 / 8.0 / 8.64, all 25.0); signing 209.0 (177.0 / 232.97 / 212.0 / 211.0, all 202.32). Skip runs: skip 7 -> 193.0, skip 9 -> 208.0. Order swap -> same terminal: True.

[Closure] policy -> tool -> computation -> GT call -> terminal: encounter charge -> enroll_encounter_charge_372696d1 -> step 7 amount 416.81 -> new ledger row; setup fee -> enroll_setup_fee_08ffaf93 -> step 9 amount 7.00 -> ledger row; signing -> sign_installment_agreement_b4bb7ade -> step 11 installment 209.00 -> plan active. required_documents = charter_scope.extended_policies. No handoff; no obligation outside the tree (the account balance, statements and hardship decision need no write).

[Solvability vs GT] step 7 evidence: plan status proposed, 36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21 unenrolled; step 9: plan proposed, request 'sign'; step 11: proposal 2026-10-01 within validity (temporal_feasibility with boundary 2026-10-15/16).

[Blind draft] From the rules, tool schemas, finder returns and the persona alone: the proposal is signable today; two states are missing; the encounter charge enrolls at 975.00 x 0.50 x 0.95 x 0.90 = 416.81; the setup fee 25 x 0.8 x 0.8 x 0.6 x 0.9 = 8.64 -> 7.00; the signing installment (5711.31/24 = 237.97 -> 214 -> 209.00) with 0.00 down and first due 2026-11-18. Agrees with gold.

[Gates, task 0] check_task_tools OK; check_extended --task 0 OK (after fixing: a module-level helper _plan was counted as an undiscoverable tool -> inlined); replay_tasks --task 0 REPLAY OK (37/37 closure); check_solvability --task 0 OK; check_compute --task 0 OK; check_grounding --task 0 OK; check_cross_fire --task 0 OK.


[Round 2 revision - policy-task audit r1 (task 0 PASS; observations closed)]
- T0-O1 (persona examples): symptom - the conditional line named both prerequisite kinds as examples ('another charge from the same surgery or a fee'); root cause - example text in a conditional reply; change - the line now reads 'If the representative tells you that something has to be booked on the plan before you can sign, you say that is fine ...', and the sixty-dollar-check line fires only if the representative brings up that bill; no_user_hint updated. Re-run: check_grounding OK, check_solvability OK.
- T0-O2 / charter O-4 (half-up vs half-even): the encounter-charge result is now RND(product + 0.000001, 2), and the rule states that an amount exactly halfway goes to the higher cent; factor_sensitivity for relief and late posting became 833.63 and 463.13 (exact ties 833.625 / 463.125); gold 416.81 unchanged. Re-run: check_compute OK.
- O-8: the encounter-charge rule no longer limits itself to charges posted after the proposal date ('a charge the financial account posts for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed plan, and not yet on that plan'), so its scope equals the signing edge's condition ('every charge ... posted for an encounter already enrolled on it').
- O-1: the flat opening definition is now labelled 'The standard enrolled amount ...' (rule and baseline.rule), like the other policies' standard cases.
- O-2: the setup-fee rule now says 'a plan carries at most one signing setup-fee entry ...; any add-on fee an active plan carries later is a separate entry', removing the reading that would void the add-on fee.
- O-3 (selector): kept XLATEST over the account for this policy - an encounter-filtered selector needs LATEST on the plan ledger, which leaves no SUM/COUNT to make the history floor bite here; on this world the rule's filter and the selector pick the same charge (verified in factor_trace). O-5 (no extra-payment tool): no change - the down payment derives to 0.00 on this world, so no payment write arises; the rule still states the base obligation. O-6, O-7, O-9 (docstrings reworded: setup-fee tool no longer names the signing occasion), O-11: see the difficulty worklog.
- Figures unchanged: encounter charge 416.81, setup fee 7.00, signed installment 209.00, first due 2026-11-18.
user_scenario: You are Nadia Whitfield, a 45-year-old middle-school librarian in Dublin, Ohio, calling the Linden Ridge Medical Group Patient Services Center on your lunch break. You speak in a warm, slightly hurried way and like to get things finished in one call. In July you had back surgery at Linden Ridge, and on October 1 a financial counselor sat down with you and set up a 24-month payment plan for what you owe from it; she told you the paperwork would stay open for two weeks and that you could call in to sign it by phone. That is why you are calling: you want to sign that payment plan today so it is in place and you can stop worrying about the surgery bill. Open with exactly that, in your own words, for example: "Hi, I'm calling to sign the payment plan the financial counselor set up for my back surgery bill - I'd like to get it signed today." You are happy for the representative to get everything on their side ready, but the signature itself is yours: when they tell you the agreement is ready and hand it to you, you sign it yourself, using exactly the plan reference and the figures they read out to you. You do not bring up any other bill, fee or account detail on your own. Your full name is Nadia Whitfield and the phone number on your file is 6145555291; give those when the representative asks who you are. Only when asked to confirm your identity, give your date of birth, 1981-06-14; if they ask for something else, your medical record number is LR5406213 and your email is nadia.whitfield@gmail.com. You remember the counselor's printout showing roughly $187 a month and a down payment of about $793, which you were dreading, but you do not know how any of it is worked out; if a figure the representative gives you is different from that printout, you simply ask them to double-check it against your records once, and whatever they then confirm, you accept. If the representative tells you that something has to be booked on the plan before you can sign, you say that is fine and ask them to go ahead; only if they themselves bring up a bill for the same surgery that came in the mail last week, you add that you mailed a sixty-dollar check toward it a few days ago. If they ask how you want to pay the monthly installments, you want to keep the automatic debit from your checking account that the counselor set up; if they ask which day of the month, you keep the 18th, as on the counselor's paperwork. If they ask how you get your statements, you get them by email, paperless. If they ask whether you have had a payment plan with Linden Ridge before, you say yes, years ago, a short one for a knee procedure that you paid off. Once the representative confirms that the plan is signed and active and tells you the monthly amount and when the first payment comes out, thank them and end the call; you have nothing else to ask for.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate Nadia Whitfield's patient profile from the name and phone number she states, returning her patient reference number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed by her customer_id; without the profile no account, plan or ledger can be found.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller is the patient by matching two stated credentials (date of birth 1981-06-14 and phone 6145555291) against the profile.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be confirmed before any account detail is discussed or any write is made; it is the scored in-session verification.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her payment plans: the proposed 24-Month Extended Plan (proposed 2026-10-01, due day 18, automatic debit ach, term 24, the counselor's stale installment 187.27 and down payment 793.13) and the paid-off 2021 6-Month plan.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Selects the plan being signed and its tier, proposal date (the 14-day validity gate), due day, automatic debit method and term; the tier parameters (setup_fee_usd 25.00, down_payment_pct 15.00, term_months 24, min_installment_usd 75.00) follow from its variant.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the plan ledgers: the proposal's only enrollment entry (charge of ENC-58302716 enrolled 2026-10-01 at 5287.50) and the old plan's enrollment and six paid installments.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows which encounter is already enrolled on the proposal, that no setup-fee entry and no enrollment for the second charge of that encounter exist yet (both prerequisite states unmet), and the plan balance the signed installment is worked out on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Patient Financial Account: Commercial PPO/POS Account opened 2013-05-06, hardship approval 55.00 through 2027-03-31, paperless statements.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the hardship-driven tiers (no down payment at signing, the setup fee's hardship share, the relief share of the late-posted charge), the tenure share, the first-phase method (PPO class) and the autopay credit (paperless); the class parameters (prompt_pay_discount_pct 5.00, prompt_pay_window_days 30, returned_payments_before_restriction 2) come with the class.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the account ledger: the late-posted charge of ENC-58302716 (posted 2026-10-06, 1120.00, estimate 780.00, service 2026-07-15) and its 60.00 check of 2026-10-09, the ACH reversal of 2026-02-17, the 2024 late fee, the six payment_plan payments of 2021-2022, and the first charge's collection, payment and hardship adjustment.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies every history input: the unenrolled charge of an enrolled encounter (the open prerequisite), its estimate cap, the returned-payment count behind the clearing method, the late-fee count (none within 12 months; the 2024 fee is a near-miss), and the six plan payments behind the returning-plan rules.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the encounter-charge enrollment tool named by the encounter-charge enrollment policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect; unlocked once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Enroll the late-posted charge of encounter ENC-58302716 on the proposed plan at the amount the encounter-charge enrollment policy computes.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Resolves the prerequisite state 'the plan carries an enrollment entry for every charge posted for an enrolled encounter'; its amount enters the plan balance the signed installment is worked out on (value_input).

argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_plan_id: Value c637bf74-c4fd-4d73-90bc-ca19da1f3135. Basis: the payment plan lookup returns exactly one plan of this patient in status proposed (24-Month Extended Plan, proposed 2026-10-01); the encounter-charge rule says the charge 'is enrolled on that plan as an initial enrollment'. Uniqueness: the only other plan of the patient is the 2021 plan in status paid_off, on which balance is never enrolled ('Balance is enrolled only while the plan status is proposed or active').
argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_txn_id: Value 36d212ad-d7ca-433a-a4b8-84d17bd30c21. Basis: the account ledger shows this charge posted 2026-10-06 for encounter ENC-58302716, the encounter the proposal already enrolled (ledger entry of 2026-10-01 pointing at f2ed445c-e7cb-4b2e-9d80-0e5ec6ea6d72); the rule: 'a charge the financial account posts, after the proposal date, for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed plan is enrolled on that plan'. Uniqueness: every other charge of the account belongs to another encounter (ENC-50417262, ENC-52290431, ENC-57118045, account-level fees) and is paid in full, and f2ed445c-e7cb-4b2e-9d80-0e5ec6ea6d72 is already enrolled; this is the only unenrolled charge of an enrolled encounter.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 416.81. Counted amount: charge 1120.00 capped at the estimate 780.00 x estimate_cap_factor 1.25 = 975.00 (Commercial PPO/POS Account, estimate above 0.00). Credited payments: 1 reversal in the 12 whole months before 2026-10-13 (ACH reversal 2026-02-17; returned_payments_before_restriction 2), so the 60.00 check of 2026-10-09 (less than one whole month old) is not credited -> 0.00; no collection, no adjustment -> remaining balance 975.00. Relief share 0.50 (approval 55.00 >= relief_deep_pct 50, through 2027-03-31 >= service 2026-07-15, no hardship adjustment on the charge). Prompt-pay rate 5.00 (posted 7 days before, window 30, automatic debit ach). Late-posting share 0.90 (posted 83 days after service >= 60). 975.00 x 0.50 x 0.95 x 0.90 = 416.8125 -> 416.81.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the setup-fee tool named by the setup-fee policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect; unlocked once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the 24-Month Extended Plan's setup fee on the plan balance at the amount the setup-fee schedule computes.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Resolves the prerequisite state 'the plan balance carries the setup-fee entry the tier owes at signing'; the fee enters the plan balance of the signed installment (value_input).

argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_plan_id: Value c637bf74-c4fd-4d73-90bc-ca19da1f3135. Basis: the setup-fee rule charges 'the plan balance' of the plan whose agreement the patient signs; the only plan being signed is the proposed 24-Month Extended Plan returned by the plan lookup. Uniqueness: the paid-off 2021 plan is closed and its tier (6-Month Interest-Free Plan) has setup_fee_usd 0.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 7.00. Scheduled setup fee = setup_fee_usd 25.00 x autopay share 0.80 (ach, no late fee within 12 whole months: the only late fee is 2024-11-14) x tenure share 0.80 (account opened 2013-05-06, 161 whole months >= 120) x hardship share 0.60 (approval 55.00 >= 50, current through 2027-03-31) x balance-size share 0.90 (enrolled charges 5704.31 with the late-posted charge, 5287.50 without it; both >= 5000 and < 10000) = 8.64. Returning-plan rule: 6 payments with method payment_plan (1..11) -> 8.64 x 0.75 = 6.48 rounded up to the whole dollar = 7.00.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the signing tool for the patient and hand it over with the plan reference, installment, down payment and first due date.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Signing is the patient's own act; the agent unlocks it for her (no DB effect).

evaluation_criteria.objective: The patient signs the agreement: the plan becomes active with the signed installment, a 0.00 down payment and installment 1 due 2026-11-18.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Root problem: the installment is computed by the signing-installment policy on the plan balance after both prerequisites landed.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_plan_id: Value c637bf74-c4fd-4d73-90bc-ca19da1f3135. Basis: the plan the patient asked to sign ('sign the payment plan the financial counselor set up') is the only proposed plan in the lookup. Uniqueness: no other plan of the patient is in status proposed.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.installment_amount: Value 209.00. Plan balance at signing = 5287.50 + 416.81 + 7.00 = 5711.31 (no reduction, no payment). Down payment 0.00 (hardship approval 55.00 current on 2026-10-13, no late fee within 12 whole months). Level installment = 5711.31 / 24 = 237.97. First phase (Commercial PPO/POS Account) = 237.97 x 0.90 = 214.17 rounded down to 214.00. Autopay credit 3.00 (ach, paperless statements). Returning-plan credit 2.00 (6 payment_plan payments, 1..11). 214.00 - 3.00 - 2.00 = 209.00, above min_installment_usd 75.00 -> 209.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.down_payment_usd: Value 0.00. Basis: signing-installment rule 'The down payment at signing is 0.00 when the financial account holds a hardship approval above 0.00 whose hardship_approved_through is on or after the signing date and shows no late fee posted less than 12 whole months before the signing date'; the account shows approval 55.00 through 2027-03-31 and its only late fee is dated 2024-11-14. Uniqueness: the half-rate tier needs no approval (0.00 approved) and the standard tier (15.00 percent, at least 250.00) applies only when neither holds; the proposal's 793.13 is the counselor's standard figure and is superseded at signing.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.first_due_date: Value 2026-11-18. Basis: payplan_agreement_and_activation 'The first due date is the first occurrence of the chosen due day that is at least first_due_days_after_signing calendar days after the signing date'; signing date 2026-10-13, first_due_days_after_signing 30 -> not earlier than 2026-11-12; the plan's due day is 18 (kept by the patient) -> 2026-11-18. Uniqueness: 2026-10-18 is fewer than 30 days after signing and 2026-12-18 is not the first such occurrence.

prompt_pay_rate_at_enrollment (parameter): posted 7 days before the enrollment date (<= prompt_pay_window_days 30) and the plan's automatic debit method is ach -> full class rate 5.00; baseline 0 -> result 438.75.
late_posting_share_at_enrollment (parameter): service 2026-07-15, posted 2026-10-06, lag 83 days >= 60 -> share 0.90; baseline 1 -> result 463.13 (975.00 x 0.50 x 0.95 = 463.125, rounded up).

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel (both point from the signing installment). Their writes do not affect one another: the encounter-charge amount reads only the charge's financial-account entries and the account (416.81 either way), and the setup fee's only plan-dependent input, the balance-size share, reads the enrolled charges total, which is 5287.50 without and 5704.31 with the encounter charge - both in the [5000, 10000) tier, share 0.90, fee 7.00 either way. A replay with the setup-fee pair (steps 8-9) moved ahead of the encounter-charge pair (steps 6-7) produced the identical terminal DB (checked by a full-state comparison: 'same terminal: True') and the same signed installment 209.00. The signing itself must come last: the prerequisite sentences state it.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 7 leaves plan_balance at 5294.50 (5287.50 + 7.00); level 220.60, first phase 198.00, installment 193.00 instead of 209.00, and the plan ledger lacks the 416.81 enrollment entry.
Skipping step 9 leaves plan_balance at 5704.31; level 237.68, first phase 213.00, installment 208.00 instead of 209.00, and the ledger lacks the 7.00 setup-fee entry.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to sign the counselor's payment plan today. Its only related lines are conditional replies that fire after the representative raises the matter (agreeing that something be booked first; mentioning the sixty-dollar check only if the representative brings up that bill).
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: In task_tools.py, sign_installment_agreement_b4bb7ade performs a single ctx.update of the plan (status active, signing date, first due date, installment, down payment) and never reads the ledger; enroll_setup_fee_08ffaf93 and enroll_encounter_charge_372696d1 each create one ledger entry and update the plan's remaining balance, with no check of status, other entries, amounts or order. Signing before either prerequisite still succeeds and writes whatever installment is passed; the omission shows only as a different terminal hash.
